name: Drowning in Sorrow
descriptionTemplate: Nymphaea gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: After Nymphaea plays a card, she gains [Energy:Arg2] Aliemus. At turn end, increase the amount of {Poison} Nymphaea inflicts by [Arg3]%.
lore:
Step by step, she slowly stepped into the sea.
The night sea, which initially felt slightly cold againt her skin, soon became as warm as a human embrace.
"The sea has accepted me," Nymphaea thought to herself.
In a daze, she saw her parents' smiles. Deep in the sea, there must surely be familial bliss.
